$comment: Metadata for each item. The build finds the files and the dependencies from the imports.

utils.title: Utils
utils.description: The cn() helper that merges Tailwind class names.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The design tokens, the light and dark themes, and the base styles.

accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: Rows that each open on what they hold, ruled off from one another.

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: A message that stays in the page, with a mark for its kind and, if it needs them, an action and a close.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: A list always in sight, with a search row at its head that filters it as you type.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: A person or a place as a picture, or their initials in a colour of their own.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: A short label in a colour: a state, a category, a count.

breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.description: The trail of pages above the current one, its middle folded when it runs long.

button.title: Button
button.description: A button with variants, sizes and a pending state.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: A month to pick a day or a stretch of days from.

card.title: Card
card.description: A box for one subject: a header with its title and action, the content, and a footer.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: A box to tick, with its label, for a yes or no and for a list of choices.

checkbox-group.title: Checkbox Group
checkbox-group.description: Several checkboxes answering one question, with its label, its hint and its error.

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: A time on wheels, out of a field: hours, minutes and the day period, scrolled or stepped with the arrows.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: A button that shows and hides what follows it, the panel opening on its own height.

color-picker.title: Color Picker
color-picker.description: One colour, picked on a square and a hue strip, typed as hex, or taken from a swatch or the screen.

combobox.title: Combobox
combobox.description: A field that filters a list as you type, and takes one of its rows.

date-picker.title: Date Picker
date-picker.description: A date typed part by part, or picked from a month that opens under it.

date-range-picker.title: Date Range Picker
date-range-picker.description: Two dates, a start and an end, typed part by part or picked from two months.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: A modal window over the page, with a title, a description and actions.

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.description: A panel that floats in from an edge, over the page, and a swipe sends back.

dropzone.title: Dropzone
dropzone.description: A place to drop files, or to choose them with a click or the keyboard.

empty-state.title: Empty State
empty-state.description: What a list, a table or a page says while it has nothing to show, and the action that fills it.

field.title: Field
field.description: A control with its label, a hint and its error, wired for assistive technology.

input.title: Input
input.description: A text field, in a box, in place or over a line.

kbd.title: Kbd
kbd.description: A key to press, written in a line of text, alone or as a combination.

listbox.title: Listbox
listbox.description: A list on the page to pick one row or several, with the keyboard or the pointer.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: A list of actions that opens from a button or a right click.

number-field.title: Number Field
number-field.description: A number typed in a box, or stepped with a minus, a plus and the arrow keys.

overflow-row.title: Overflow Row
overflow-row.description: Items on one line, as many as fit, the rest counted in a chip that names them.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: The pages of a long list: the ends, the current one with its neighbours, and an ellipsis for the rest.

pin-input.title: Pin Input
pin-input.description: One box per character, for a PIN or the code a message brings.

popover.title: Popover
popover.description: A small panel that opens from a button, for a few fields or a closer look.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: How far a task that takes time has gone, or that it is still going.

radio-group.title: Radio Group
radio-group.description: One answer out of a few options, all of them in sight.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: A score on a small scale, given with a press on a star or with the arrows.

search-field.title: Search Field
search-field.description: A box for a search query, with a magnifier, a cross that empties it and Escape that does the same.

select.title: Select
select.description: A form field with one or more values from a list of options.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: A line between two groups, or one that the pointer and the keys move to size a pane.

slider.title: Slider
slider.description: A number, or a range of two, picked by moving a thumb along a track.

stepper.title: Stepper
stepper.description: The steps of a process and where it stands: done, current and ahead, in a row or a column.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: An on and off setting that takes effect at once, with its label.

table.title: Table
table.description: Rows of data in columns, sorted, resized and chosen with the pointer or the keyboard.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Sections of one place, one in view at a time, picked from a strip or a rail.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: A field for a few lines of text, growing with what is typed.

time-picker.title: Time Picker
time-picker.description: A time typed part by part, or picked from wheels that open under it.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: A short message about something that happened, in a corner, for a few seconds.

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.description: A button that stays in when pressed, and out when pressed again.

toggle-group.title: Toggle Group
toggle-group.description: Toggles side by side, one of them in or several, reached by the arrow keys.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A short line that describes a control, under the pointer or the keyboard focus.

transfer-list.title: Transfer List
transfer-list.description: Two lists side by side, with buttons that move rows from one to the other.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: Nested rows that open and close, to pick one or several.
